home.hero_subtitle: DEPRO is the software that generates periodization, sessions and load tracking for coaches, clubs and players. One product. Three profiles. All centralized.
home.hero_trial_note: 15-day free trial on all plans. Cancel anytime.
home.product_title: Everything you need for physical preparation
home.product_desc: A SaaS platform built exclusively for football. AI generates microcycles, modular sessions and load alerts — no spreadsheets or generic templates.

product_features.title: AI periodization
product_features.desc: Microcycles and mesocycles generated based on calendar, matches and team goals.

product_features.title: Automatic sessions
product_features.desc: Warm-up, main and cool-down blocks with defined loads, spaces and intensity.

product_features.title: Load control
product_features.desc: Per-player load traffic light. GPS integration and smart risk classification.

product_features.title: Multi-role dashboard
product_features.desc: Coach, trainer, medical staff and management see what they need from one ecosystem.

product_features.title: Club white-label
product_features.desc: Club logo, colors and categories applied across the entire platform.

product_features.title: Individual player plan
product_features.desc: Monthly plans adapted to age, position, equipment and frequency — accessible from any club.

home.pricing_desc: Monthly subscription. No commitment. All plans include AI-generated content.
home.pricing_trial_badge: All plans include a 15-day free trial
home.pricing_footnote: Prices in EUR · VAT not included · 15-day free trial · Cancel anytime
home.pricing_coach_desc: For trainers and coaches managing one or more teams independently.
home.pricing_club_desc: For clubs that want to centralize physical preparation across all categories.
home.pricing_player_desc: For players who want an individual physical preparation plan, with or without a club referral code.
home.referral_title: Your club brings players. Everyone wins.
home.referral_desc: Clubs with an active plan receive a unique referral code. Their players access individual plans at a discount, and the club earns monthly credit on their subscription.

referral_steps.title: Club activates plan
referral_steps.desc: Access the platform with own branding and generate a DEPRO-CLUB-XXXX code.

referral_steps.title: Share with players
referral_steps.desc: Academy players register with the code and get a discount on their individual plan.

referral_steps.title: Automatic credit
referral_steps.desc: For each active referred player, the club receives credit on their monthly invoice — no manual management.

home.process_title: From signup to training in minutes

process_steps.title: Choose your profile
process_steps.desc: Coach, club or player. Select the plan that fits your scale.

process_steps.title: Set up your context
process_steps.desc: Calendar, categories, squad and goals. AI does the rest.

process_steps.title: Receive your periodization
process_steps.desc: Microcycle and sessions generated automatically, ready for the field.

process_steps.title: Monitor and adjust
process_steps.desc: Load, tests and real-time alerts. AI adapts the plan every week.

home.about_title: Physical preparation software. Not a fitness app.
home.about_desc_1: DEPRO was built to solve a specific problem: physical preparation in football requires rigorous periodization, load tracking and staff coordination — and most clubs do it with Excel and WhatsApp.
home.about_desc_2: We are a specialized SaaS. AI doesn't replace the trainer: it automates the repetitive so staff can focus on what matters — reading the player and making decisions.
home.contact_subtitle: Tell us your profile and we'll help you choose the right plan.
home.contact_goal_placeholder: Tell us your situation: categories, number of teams, goals...
home.contact_club_code_hint: If you come from a club with a DEPRO plan, enter their code for a discount.
